design_name: Local-gated abstaining neighbor portfolio method development
status: outcome-informed method-development design frozen after aggregate Caltech results but before candidate-level transfer-opportunity calculations
claim_guard: Caltech candidate outcomes have already informed the method family. Results may demonstrate internal mechanics, candidate attribution, and ablation behavior on the observed target, but cannot establish independent transfer, prospective acceleration, or new science.
scientific_question: Can useful neighbor rankings be preserved more effectively by borrowing only where the target is unfamiliar, the source is locally supported, and initial target labels agree with the source direction, while allowing every source to abstain?

campaign.primary_endpoint: AUC of cumulative true-top-5-percent recovery through acquisition 20
secondary_endpoints: unique true-top candidates contributed by each source

transfer_opportunity.source_global_qualification: q_s=max(0,(Spearman(source prediction,target labels)-0.10)/0.90)*n/(n+20), using only the initial target labels; q_s=0 means source-level abstention
transfer_opportunity.target_ood: percentile rank of nearest-initial-label distance in the development-standardized composition space
transfer_opportunity.source_support: one minus the percentile rank of nearest-source-entity distance in source-standardized composition space
transfer_opportunity.local_concordance: positive part of Spearman correlation between source prediction and target outcome among the 12 nearest initial target labels, multiplied by 12/(12+12); nonpositive local correlation means candidate-level abstention
transfer_opportunity.candidate_gate: target OOD percentile >=0.50, source support percentile >=0.50, source qualification >0, and local concordance >0
transfer_opportunity.source_candidate_score: source prediction percentile * source qualification * target OOD percentile * source support percentile * local concordance inside the gate, otherwise zero
transfer_opportunity.shuffled_source: seed-specific permutation of the OBELiX prediction with OBELiX source-support geometry retained

portfolio.base_score: sum of the positive source-candidate scores after converting each positive source score to a within-pool percentile while preserving exact zeros
portfolio.diversity: at each selection, add 0.25 times the percentile rank of nearest-selected-candidate composition distance to 0.75 times the base score rank
portfolio.fallback: when no candidate has positive neighbor score, choose sequential composition novelty relative to initial and already selected target entities
portfolio.abstention: a source contributes exactly zero outside its global or candidate-level gate
portfolio.tie_break: highest score, then highest composition novelty, then lexicographically smallest canonical composition

interpretation.full_vs_static: tests whether qualification and local opportunity improve over preserving unqualified static rankings
interpretation.full_vs_global: tests whether candidate-level concordance adds value beyond one global source weight
interpretation.full_vs_no_support: tests whether source familiarity is necessary
interpretation.full_vs_no_ood: tests whether targeting target-model unfamiliarity is necessary
interpretation.full_vs_no_diversity: tests whether composition diversity adds value beyond score ranking
interpretation.wrong_and_shuffled: tests whether the same algorithm suppresses unrelated or destroyed source information

candidate_attribution.output: one row per scope, candidate, and source with selection frequency and mean gate components across seeds
candidate_attribution.hypothesis_cards: retrospective method-development cards for an OBELiX-dominant hit, an ESTM-dominant hit, a consensus hit, and a high-ranked false positive, each with an outcome-free composition-nearest control
candidate_attribution.new_science_guard: cards demonstrate the reporting format only; a source-derived hypothesis must be written before target outcome access on the next target

uncertainty.unit: initial-target-label seed conditional on the single observed Caltech database
uncertainty.dataset_level_warning: seed intervals are not external-target uncertainty and cannot validate general transfer
